[[File:Jabba_message.png|thumb|Jabba reading Sebulba's private note]]
{{Quote|I will give you a thrust cone. But first you must take this message to Jabba the Hutt. And bring back his answer.|Sebulba to DUM-4|<ref name="APD">''[[Anakin's Pit Droid]]''</ref>}}
A few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before the start of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve classic of 32 BBY]], the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] racer [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] tasked the droid [[DUM-4/Legends|DUM-4]] with the delivery of '''a private message''' to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He insisted on the note being given to the Hutt personally, and told the droid to come back with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] answer. DUM-4 then proceeded to reach [[Jabba's private box]] and held him out the sheet of [[Paper/Legends|paper]]. The actual content of the message is unknown, but Jabba actually read it with interest and answered immediately. When he received the note back, Sebulba also expressed his approval by nodding quietly.<ref name="APD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The context of the message hints that Jabba and Sebulba might have been in collusion. In ''[[Podracing Tales]]'', the Hutt's droid [[R5-X2/Legends|R5-X2]] estimated that Sebulba would win the race,<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref> so they may have organized the sabotage on other [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] together.
